title: Two metabolites of anti-cerebral-apoplexy medicine pinocembrin and synthetic methods of the two metabolites
abstract: The invention discloses synthetic methods of two metabolites of an anti-cerebral-apoplexy medicine pinocembrin to obtain two chemical compounds pinocembrin-7-O-beta-D-glucuronic acid and sodium pinocembrin-7-O-sulfonate. The pinocembrin-7-O-beta-D-glucuronic acid adopts the pinocembrin as a raw material. The pinocembrin is protected by acetylation, then deprotected selectively, subjected to glycosylation with tri-O-acetyl-alpha-D-bromomethylglucuronate, and deprotected to obtain the objective compound. The sodium pinocembrin-7-O-sulfonate adopts the pinocembrin as a raw material and adopts pyridine as a solvent and a catalyst. The pinocembrin and chlorosulfonic acid are subjected to a sulfonation reaction, and salified to obtain the corresponding objective compound. The two objective compounds can be used for providing standard substances for studying metabolic pathways of the pinocembrin.
